title: Pink Alien on Mossy Rock
description: A cute pink octopus-like alien with large black eyes and two antennae sits atop a dark moss-covered rock. The creature is surrounded by floating bright orange squares against a solid teal-green background.
prompt: A cute pink octopus-like alien creature with two antennae ending in pink spheres and large glossy black eyes, perched on a dark gray rock covered in green moss. The alien has multiple tentacles and a friendly expression. Bright orange glowing squares of various sizes float all around it against a solid teal green background, whimsical digital painting style.
